description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Greenwarden of Murasa and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Sacrifice from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing a Greenwarden of Murasa token, adding an amount of {B} equal to its mana value. 
Repeat.
